# Ironclad Commercial Floors

> Ironclad Commercial Floors is a commercial flooring contractor in Vancouver, BC. We handle commercial flooring installation, repair and replacement, commercial epoxy flooring, garage epoxy flooring, concrete floor polishing, luxury vinyl, sheet vinyl and carpet tile across Metro Vancouver.
